**PotentialWax 1.2.1**: name tidy-up.

- The title on the plugin's page now reads **PotentialWax**, the same as in the MPC's plugin list (it was in all capitals). Sound and controls are unchanged.

Saved projects keep working. **Download** `PotentialWax-1.2.1-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
